decisions.left_group: Existing registry-ui-checkboxes: Найдено: N, then existing filter-sep only if the page has a checkbox, then the page's native checkbox and clickable label. The divider is 1×18 px #DEDAD0 with 20 px visual gap on each side; divider and checkbox stay paired when a long summary wraps.
decisions.right_group: One existing registry-ui-reset is first in toolbar-right, before page filters/select/sort; search remains last at the right. Exact button text: Сбросить фильтр. No similar page-local visual class or duplicate reset handler.
decisions.geometry: At a fixed viewport, showing or hiding reset preserves X/Y of select and search and toolbar height. If space is insufficient, the whole right group has a stable second row in both states. Verify 390, 900, 1280, 1920 and 3840 CSS px and neighboring wrap widths.
decisions.hidden: Hidden reset is absent from keyboard Tab order and accessibility tree. The ordinary v019 group removes it from layout; dense departures and closing filters may reserve an invisible slot using shared CSS visibility:hidden to preserve control geometry.
decisions.reset: Visible on any deviation from each page's initial filter/tab/checkbox/sort/search profile; restores that exact profile, clears search, persists the result by the established state scope and becomes hidden. Existing business behavior is retained.

checkbox_pages./erpv2/company/finance/received-paid: Показать завершённые: unchecked by default; checked includes fully completed settlements; reset returns unchecked. Persist under showComplete, never invert legacy hideComplete state.
checkbox_pages./erpv2/company/feo/requests/map-placemen: Не показывать отключённые: checked by default; continue hiding disabled blocks.
checkbox_pages./erpv2/company/feo/requests/transfers: Показать возвращённые: unchecked by default; returned blocks appear only when checked. Reset also restores Нетто and empty search.

decisions.other_pages: The seven other registered pages do not acquire a new checkbox or divider.
decisions.visual_source: Reuse registry-components.css, registry-ui-* and existing filter-sep; reset height 32 px and existing IBM Plex Sans 12/500/16, brown checkbox 16×16, approved focus/hover states. The map placement toolbar's existing btn--toolbar aligns to the same 32 px control row.
